en.title: Natalie Portman's 'Good Sex' Rom-Com Lands Spring 2027 Netflix Release
en.summary: Lena Dunham's highly anticipated romantic comedy starring Natalie Portman is officially heading to Netflix. The film, a major acquisition for the streamer, is set to debut in Spring 2027.
en.body:
Netflix has officially set its sights on Spring 2027 for **Lena Dunham**'s star-studded romantic comedy, **Good Sex**. The film, which features **Natalie Portman** in the lead role, was a hot commodity, reportedly landing at Netflix after an intense bidding war for a staggering $55 million. This move signals Netflix's continued investment in high-profile feature films aimed at a broad audience.

**Good Sex** centers on Ally, a pragmatic couples' therapist played by **Portman**. Approaching 40 and recovering from a decade-long failed relationship, Ally reluctantly re-enters the New York City dating scene. Her journey takes an unexpected turn when she finds herself involved with two very different men: one in his twenties and another in his fifties. The film promises to explore the complexities of modern dating and the idea that there's no single formula for a fulfilling romantic and sexual life.

## A Star-Studded Ensemble and a Director's Vision

**Natalie Portman** is the first confirmed cast member, bringing her considerable talent to the role of Ally. The ensemble cast is expected to be rounded out by a host of notable names, including **Mark Ruffalo**, **Tucker Pillsbury** (also known as the singer from the band Role Model), **Tramell Tillman**, **Rashida Jones**, and the legendary **Meg Ryan**. The film is written, produced, and directed by **Lena Dunham**, who recently signed a first-look deal with Netflix. This collaboration between Dunham and Portman, two prominent figures in contemporary filmmaking, has generated considerable anticipation. The production is backed by MountainA and Good Thing Going Productions, with **Portman** herself serving as a producer.

## What This Means for Rom-Com Fans

The romantic comedy genre has seen a resurgence in recent years, with platforms like Netflix playing a key role in its revival. Shows like **Sex Education**, while a series, have demonstrated a keen understanding of audience desires for relatable, often humorous, explorations of relationships and intimacy. **Good Sex** appears poised to tap into that same vein, offering a mature yet engaging look at dating over 40. The film's premise, exploring unconventional age gaps and the search for connection, is likely to resonate with viewers who appreciate stories that challenge traditional romantic tropes. With a Spring 2027 release window, fans have a clear target, though specific promotional materials and a concrete premiere date are still on the horizon.

## What's Next

With a confirmed Spring 2027 release window, **Good Sex** is firmly on the radar for rom-com enthusiasts. Fans can expect further casting announcements and plot details to emerge as the release date approaches, likely in early 2027.

content_raw: Picture: Natalie Portman (left) and Lena Dunham (right) Lena Dunham’s upcoming Netflix romantic-comedy, Good Sex , is set for a Spring 2027 release! The film stars Natalie Portman as Ally, who, after a failed 10-year relationship and on the cusp of turning 40, dips her toe back into the New York dating scene, only to get more than she bargained for when she meets two men: one in his twenties and one in his fifties. Here is everything we know so far about Good Sex on Netflix. Good Sex is an upcoming Netflix Original romantic comedy film written and directed by Lena Dunham. At the start of 2025, Dunham signed a first-look deal with Netflix . The film was the subject of an intense bidding war, which Netflix ultimately won with a $55 million bid .  The executive producers are Tim Bevan, Michael Sledd, and Michaela Celella for MountainA. Natalie Portman and Sophie Mas are producers through Mountain A, while Lena Dunham is also a producer, alongside Michael Cohen, through Good Thing Going Productions. When is Good Sex coming to Netflix? Netflix has set a Spring 2027 (March-May) release window for Good Sex . We expect an official release date for Good Sex to be confirmed in early 2027. What is the plot of Good Sex ? Netflix has provided a synopsis for Good Sex: “Logline: After spending a decade in a failed relationship, pragmatic couples’ therapist Ally is turning 40 and reluctantly dipping her toe back into the New York dating scene. But she gets more than she bargained for when she meets two men- one in his twenties and one in his fifties- who show her there is no set formula for good sex.” Who are the cast members of Good Sex ? Natalie Portman was the first confirmed cast member for the film. The actress has starred in Netflix films that were released internationally, such as Annihilation and May December . She is best known for playing Padmé Amidala in the Star Wars franchise and for her Academy Award-winning role as Nina Sayers in Darren Aronofsky’s Black Swan . She plays the role of Ally. Picture: Natalie Portman in Annihilation (left) and May December (right). Mark Ruffalo , Tucker Pillsbury , Rashida Jones , and Meg Ryan have also been cast. Ruffalo has starred in two Netflix Originals, Shawn Levy’s Adam Project and the limited series All the Light We Cannot See . Picture: Mark Ruffalo in The Adam Project (left) and All the Light We Cannot See (right) Meanwhile, this will be the first acting role for Tucker Pillsbury , better known professionally as the singer ROLE MODEL, known for his studio albums Rx and Kansas Anymore. Watch the video Rashida Jones is best known for starring as Ann Perkins in the beloved comedy series Parks and Recreation . Meg Ryan is a legend amongst rom-com fans, having starred in classics such as When Harry Met Sally , Sleepless in Seattle , and You’ve Got Mail .
